```python
from seedemu import Emulator, Base, Routing, Ebgp, Ibgp, Ospf, WebService
from seedemu.layers import LayerDatabase
from seedemu.core import AutonomousSystem, InternetExchange, PeerRelationship
from seedemu.services import WebServer
from seedemu.services.remoteaccess import OpenVpnRemoteAccessProvider

# Create the emulator and layers
emu = Emulator()
base = Base()
routing = Routing()
ebgp = Ebgp()
ibgp = Ibgp()
ospf = Ospf()
web = WebService()

# Create Internet Exchanges with custom display names
ix1 = InternetExchange(1)
ix1.setDisplayName("IX Frankfurt")
ix2 = InternetExchange(2)
ix2.setDisplayName("IX Amsterdam")
ix3 = InternetExchange(3)
ix3.setDisplayName("IX London")
base.addInternetExchange(ix1)
base.addInternetExchange(ix2)
base.addInternetExchange(ix3)

# Create Transit Autonomous Systems
transit1 = AutonomousSystem(100)
transit1.setDisplayName("Transit AS 100")
transit2 = AutonomousSystem(200)
transit2.setDisplayName("Transit AS 200")
base.addAutonomousSystem(transit1)
base.addAutonomousSystem(transit2)

# Create single-homed stub Autonomous Systems with various services
stub1 = AutonomousSystem(101)
stub1.setDisplayName("Stub AS 101")
stub2 = AutonomousSystem(102)
stub2.setDisplayName("Stub AS 102")
stub3 = AutonomousSystem(103)
stub3.setDisplayName("Stub AS 103")
base.addAutonomousSystem(stub1)
base.addAutonomousSystem(stub2)
base.addAutonomousSystem(stub3)

# Add hosts to stub ASes and add web services
host1 = stub1.createHost('host1')
host2 = stub2.createHost('host2')
host3 = stub3.createHost('host3')
web.addService(WebServer('host1', 80), 101)
web.addService(WebServer('host2', 80), 102)
web.addService(WebServer('host3', 80), 103)

# Add a host with a customized IP address to one of the Autonomous Systems
custom_host = stub1.createHost('customhost')
custom_host.setAddress('10.10.10.10/24')

# Create a real-world Autonomous System
real_as = AutonomousSystem(64512)
real_as.setDisplayName("Real World AS 64512")
base.addAutonomousSystem(real_as)
base.addRealWorldRoute(64512, "8.8.8.0/24")

# Connect ASes to Internet Exchanges
stub1.joinInternetExchange(1)
stub2.joinInternetExchange(2)
stub3.joinInternetExchange(3)
transit1.joinInternetExchange(1)
transit1.joinInternetExchange(2)
transit2.joinInternetExchange(2)
transit2.joinInternetExchange(3)
real_as.joinInternetExchange(1)

# Enable remote access to one of the AS's network
vpn = OpenVpnRemoteAccessProvider()
vpn.setFrontendPort(1194)
vpn.setDescription("Remote VPN Access for AS 101")
stub1.enableRemoteAccess(vpn)

# Set up peering via a route server and private peering with different peer relationships
# Add a route server to IX Amsterdam (IX 2)
ebgp.addRsPeer(2, 100)  # Transit1 as RS peer at IX 2
ebgp.addRsPeer(2, 200)  # Transit2 as RS peer at IX 2

# Private peering between stub1 and stub2 (customer-provider)
ebgp.addPrivatePeering(101, 100, PeerRelationship.CustomerProvider)
# Private peering between stub3 and transit2 (peer-peer)
ebgp.addPrivatePeering(103, 200, PeerRelationship.PeerPeer)
# Private peering between transit1 and real_as (provider-customer)
ebgp.addPrivatePeering(100, 64512, PeerRelationship.ProviderCustomer)

# Add all layers to the emulator
emu.addLayer(base)
emu.addLayer(routing)
emu.addLayer(ebgp)
emu.addLayer(ibgp)
emu.addLayer(ospf)
emu.addLayer(web)

# Save the emulator to a component file
emu.save('emulation-component.bin')

# Render and compile the emulator
emu.render()
emu.compile()
```
